partnershipPlan: Two night technologists and the community clinic network lead review the definitions before extraction; a patient partner reviews the plain-language summary for the laboratory director.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: At three in the morning I have a blood culture flagging, two potassiums to phone and the chemistry analyser alarming, and I am the only one here.
items.implication: Measure night staffing as a factor and report delays by time block.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The clinic shut at five; the on-call number on our list rings a doctor who left last year.
Composite paraphrase: They rang me the next day to say my potassium had been dangerously high the evening before, and I had been at home alone all night.
items.implication: Keep community after-hours results as the key subgroup.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: In the emergency department I take the call and repeat it back, but I do not always hear whether they logged it.
items.implication: Report read-back documentation as a process outcome.

summary: Four composite voices on night workload, unreachable clinics, patients at home and read-back.
